Attributed ASTIS-authored scoped mathematical restatement/completion.
Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert Borel space with canonical volume, including rank zero as an explicit extension of the source Euclidean setting. Let V:E→ℝ be C2, 0<α≤β, and α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for all x,v. Let η>0 and βη≤1. Set μ=volume.tilted(−V), J=Law(X,X+√ηZ) for independent X∼μ,Z∼N(0,I), ν=J.snd. Let P be the actual conditional-expectation orthogonal projection onto the second-coordinate sigma algebra in L²(J). For the canonical isometric pullback M u(x,y)=u(y), both J and ν are probabilities, ran M=ran P, and ∫Mu dJ=∫u dν for every u∈L²(ν). Consequently M maps the full zero-mean subspace of L²(ν) onto exactly {f∈ran P:∫f dJ=0}. No caller onto, centering, probability or law certificate is assumed.

{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ)*‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ)*‖v‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ)*η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map
      (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2))
    let ν := J.snd
    let hp : MeasurePreserving (Prod.snd : E × E → E) J ν :=
      ⟨measurable_snd,rfl⟩
    let M : Lp ℝ 2 ν →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 J :=
      Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢ ℝ Prod.snd hp
    let P : Lp ℝ 2 J →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 J :=
      (lpMeas ℝ ℝ (MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.snd (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace E))
        2 J).subtypeL ∘L condExpL2 ℝ ℝ measurable_snd.comap_le
    IsProbabilityMeasure J ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
      M.toLinearMap.range = P.toLinearMap.range ∧
      (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, (∫ p, (M u) p ∂J) = ∫ y, u y ∂ν) ∧
      M '' {u : Lp ℝ 2 ν | (∫ y, u y ∂ν)=0} =
        {f : Lp ℝ 2 J | f ∈ P.toLinearMap.range ∧ (∫ p, f p ∂J)=0}
decoder_context: The underlying space is a finite-dimensional real Hilbert Borel space with canonical volume, including zero dimension. The potential is C2, positive alpha<=beta, both displayed global Hessian bounds, eta>0, beta*eta<=1.

Measure.tilted is normalized exponential tilting. The first law is volume tilted by the negative potential, the joint is the pushforward of its product with the standard Gaussian under the displayed add-noise map, and the marginal is the second coordinate law.

The displayed canonical pullback maps a real marginal L2 class to its second-coordinate joint L2 class. The displayed projection is conditional expectation onto the second-coordinate sigma algebra. LinearMap.range is the actual image submodule; image of the zero-integral set denotes all centered classes, not an input onto certificate.

import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.L2PullbackRange
import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.GibbsAugmentation
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.ConditionalExpectation.CondexpL2

/-! Actual PBPS Appendix B macro-space identification. The reverse range and
centered image use genuine measurable factorization, the actual Gaussian-Gibbs
law and pushforward means. This is not a defect square-root/inverse theorem.
Original C2/two Hessian/capped scale are retained; finite real Hilbert/rank zero
is an explicitly disclosed extension. No finite-dimensional assumption on L2. -/

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped ContDiff NNReal Topology
namespace AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.MacroscopicRange
noncomputable section
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem actual_macroscopic_centered_range
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ)*‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ)*‖v‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ)*η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map
      (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2))
    let ν := J.snd
    let hp : MeasurePreserving (Prod.snd : E × E → E) J ν :=
      ⟨measurable_snd,rfl⟩
    let M : Lp ℝ 2 ν →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 J :=
      Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢ ℝ Prod.snd hp
    let P : Lp ℝ 2 J →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 J :=
      (lpMeas ℝ ℝ (MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.snd (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace E))
        2 J).subtypeL ∘L condExpL2 ℝ ℝ measurable_snd.comap_le
    IsProbabilityMeasure J ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
      M.toLinearMap.range = P.toLinearMap.range ∧
      (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, (∫ p, (M u) p ∂J) = ∫ y, u y ∂ν) ∧
      M '' {u : Lp ℝ 2 ν | (∫ y, u y ∂ν)=0} =
        {f : Lp ℝ 2 J | f ∈ P.toLinearMap.range ∧ (∫ p, f p ∂J)=0} := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
  let J := (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map
    (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2))
  let ν := J.snd
  let hp : MeasurePreserving (Prod.snd : E × E → E) J ν := ⟨measurable_snd,rfl⟩
  let M : Lp ℝ 2 ν →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 J := Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢ ℝ Prod.snd hp
  let S := lpMeas ℝ ℝ (MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.snd
    (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace E)) 2 J
  let P : Lp ℝ 2 J →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 J :=
    S.subtypeL ∘L condExpL2 ℝ ℝ measurable_snd.comap_le
  obtain ⟨_,hJ,_⟩ := GibbsAugmentation.normalized_augmentation_density
    hα hV (fun x v => (hH x v).1) hη
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure J := hJ
  have hν : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := by infer_instance
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
  letI : Fact ((MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.snd
    (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace E)) ≤ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (E × E))) :=
    ⟨measurable_snd.comap_le⟩
  have hMrange : M.toLinearMap.range = S :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Measure.L2PullbackRange.l2_pullback_range_eq_lpMeas hp
  have hPdef : P = S.starProjection := rfl
  have hPrange : P.toLinearMap.range = S := by
    change P.range = S
    rw [hPdef]
    exact S.range_starProjection
  have hRange : M.toLinearMap.range = P.toLinearMap.range := hMrange.trans hPrange.symm
  have hMean (u : Lp ℝ 2 ν) : (∫ p, (M u) p ∂J) = ∫ y, u y ∂ν := by
    calc
      (∫ p, (M u) p ∂J) = ∫ p : E × E, u p.2 ∂J :=
        integral_congr_ae (Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving u hp)
      _ = ∫ y, u y ∂ν :=
        (integral_map measurable_snd.aemeasurable (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable u)).symm
  refine ⟨hJ,hν,hRange,hMean,?_⟩
  ext f
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u,hu,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
    · rw [← hRange]
      exact ⟨u,rfl⟩
    · rw [hMean]
      exact hu
  · rintro ⟨hf,hfmean⟩
    have hfM : f ∈ M.toLinearMap.range := by rwa [hRange]
    obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := hfM
    refine ⟨u,?_,hu⟩
    change M u=f at hu
    change (∫ y, u y ∂ν)=0
    rw [← hMean u,hu]
    exact hfmean

end
end AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.MacroscopicRange

steps.title: Produce the actual probabilities
steps.text: The existing normalized Gibbs augmentation theorem under the original lower curvature and positive η produces probability μ and J internally. The true second marginal ν is therefore probability; no normalization certificate is a premise.

steps.title: Identify both ranges with the same closed subspace
steps.text: Apply the shared exact pullback-range theorem to the actual measure-preserving second projection. The actual conditional expectation is definitionally the Hilbert orthogonal projection onto that same lpMeas submodule, whose range equals the submodule.

steps.title: Transport the actual mean
steps.text: The canonical pullback agrees AE with u∘snd. Integration against the true pushforward ν=J.snd gives ∫Mu dJ=∫u dν. L2 functions are L1 here because J and ν are probabilities; no injectivity or embedding of snd is assumed.

steps.title: Obtain the full centered image
steps.text: Forward range membership and mean transport send every centered u to a centered macro class. Conversely, every centered f in ranP lies in ranM; choosing its actual preimage and applying mean transport proves that preimage centered. Thus the equality is onto the entire centered macro subspace.
